general.title: Agentenblick
general.description: See the crawlers and agents visiting your shop, with the evidence behind each identity.
general.empty: No requests observed for this period and sales channel yet.
general.noAgents: No crawler or agent traffic observed for this selection.
general.scope: Only requests reaching Shopware are observed. Ordinary-looking browser agents may remain unidentified. Sessions are provisional; a shared agent key can group several visits. All dates use UTC.

metrics.shareHint: Verified or declared agent sessions divided by all observed sessions. Suspected automation is excluded from the numerator.
metrics.agentSessionsHint: Crawlers and agents, verified or declared.

trend.title: Sessions over time
trend.accessible: Daily total, verified or declared agent sessions and separately suspected automation. Exact values are available in the table below.

breakdown.proofHint: Requests retain their own evidence. Sessions use the strongest proof observed during collection; deferred verification applies stricter rules.

table.caption: Observed agents and their identity evidence
table.proofHint: A declared identity is not verified and is not proof of impersonation. Mixed evidence is shown separately, with request counts. Suspected automation is not proof of AI or operator identity.
table.retentionHint: Last seen and top routes use retained request details. A generic route means Shopware did not expose a resolved route, for example on a cache hit.

proxy.title: Check your trusted proxy configuration
proxy.description: Most resolved client IPs in the current observation window belong to known CDN ranges. IP verification may be using the CDN address instead of the visitor address. This is not proof of impersonation.
proxy.remediation: Configure only your actual proxy addresses in TRUSTED_PROXIES and the forwarded headers trusted by Symfony. The proxy must overwrite visitor-supplied headers. Verify the result of Request::getClientIp(). The warning clears when a new hourly window no longer has a CDN majority.

ranges.title: IP range updates awaiting review
ranges.description: These official lists changed by more than 30%. The existing ranges remain active until an editor approves the proposed version.
ranges.confirmText: Replace the current {current} ranges with the proposed {proposed} ranges? Review the differences and the operator's official source before applying this version.
ranges.truncated: The first 50 added and removed ranges are shown. Check the official source for the complete list.
ranges.approved: The reviewed IP range version is now active.
ranges.changed: The proposed ranges changed while you were reviewing them. Review the refreshed version before approving.

errors.load: Traffic could not be loaded for this selection. Please try again.
errors.export: The CSV could not be downloaded. Try again or check your viewing permission.
errors.approve: The IP ranges could not be approved. Check your editor permission and try again.
errors.permission: You do not have permission to view Agentenblick.

benchmark.title: Contribute to the Shopware benchmark
benchmark.description: Participation is optional and disabled by default. Review the exact weekly payload below before enabling automatic submission to the Aithos benchmark.
benchmark.demo: Demonstration mode: synthetic data is kept separate from merchant benchmark submissions.
benchmark.offline: Offline mode is active. No benchmark network requests are made. Previews and the local journal remain available.
benchmark.withdrawalPending: Participation has stopped locally. Server-side deletion is pending and will be retried when network access is available.

privacy.aggregate: Only completed ISO-week aggregates are sent: percentage shares rounded to 0.1 point, broad segments and a random installation identifier. Sales-channel keys are pseudonymised in the transmitted payload.
privacy.excluded: No raw IP, visitor or session identifier, shop domain, request body, query string, order identifier or individual request is sent.
privacy.threshold: A denominator below 10 sessions suppresses that shop metric. A published benchmark metric requires at least 5 eligible installations; several channels from one shop count as one contributor.
privacy.retention: Submissions are retained for 13 months. Participation can be withdrawn; this stops future submissions and requests deletion of that installation’s retained submissions.
privacy.journey: Version 2 adds independently observed journey-step shares and named failure shares, split by verified and declared agents. Only eligible sessions with known outcomes enter failure denominators; no missing step is inferred.

benchmark.methodology: Read the public methodology and privacy rules
benchmark.consent: I have reviewed the payload preview and methodology. I agree to send the described weekly traffic, journey and failure aggregates to the Aithos benchmark under consent version 2. No individual request, session or order is sent. I can withdraw at any time.
benchmark.editorRequired: Editor permission is required to enable participation, send aggregates or withdraw.
benchmark.previewHint: This preview is generated locally. Opening or refreshing it does not send data to the benchmark.
benchmark.previewPrivacy: The JSON below shows the exact payload bytes, including suppressed values. Local channel identifiers shown in this interface are not transmitted as such.
benchmark.noPreview: There are no completed weeks available for a payload yet.
benchmark.historyHint: Inspect the exact payload and its hash for each local submission. Dates use UTC.
benchmark.noHistory: No submissions have been prepared or sent yet.
benchmark.comparisonHint: Published figures use comparable, disjoint cohorts. The median is an installation-level share; quartiles describe the middle half of published values.
benchmark.comparisonNetwork: Fetching the benchmark contacts shopware.aithos.app. This action requires participation to be enabled and offline mode to be off.
benchmark.insufficient: No comparable metric can be displayed. It may be unpublished, unavailable, or below the five-installation threshold.
benchmark.withdrawText: Stop future submissions and request deletion of retained submissions for this installation? Local traffic measurement continues.
benchmark.withdrawOffline: Offline mode prevents the deletion request from being sent now. The request will remain pending until network access is available.

success.disable: Participation is stopped. Check the status of the deletion request.
success.send: Pending aggregates have been processed. Check the submission journal for each result.

error.load: The local benchmark settings could not be loaded. Please try again.
error.update: The action could not be confirmed. Refresh the local status and check your editor permission before trying again.
error.compare: The benchmark could not be retrieved. Please try again later.
error.send: The submission could not be completed. Inspect its status in the local journal.

benchmark.localShare: This shop: agent share by channel

comparisonReason.demo_dashboard_authentication_required: Demonstration benchmarks require partner authentication. Open the research dashboard to view synthetic cohorts.
comparisonReason.offline: Offline mode prevents fetching the benchmark.
comparisonReason.disabled: Enable participation before fetching a comparison.
comparisonReason.withdrawal_pending: A comparison is unavailable while the withdrawal request is pending.

benchmark.identityConflict: This test environment contains an existing real installation identity. Activation, submissions, comparisons and server deletion are blocked. Use a separate demonstration identity; do not reuse the production identity from a cloned database.
benchmark.consentUpdate: The benchmark now includes journey and failure shares. New submissions are paused until you explicitly accept consent version 2. Existing frozen documents remain unchanged; withdrawal is still available.

journey.description: Local journeys of classified crawlers, agents and separately suspected automation. Ordinary human or unidentified request details are not retained. All dates use UTC.
journey.loadFailed: The journeys could not be loaded for this selection. Please try again.
journey.detailFailed: This journey is unavailable, outside the selected period/channel, or no longer retained.
journey.funnelHint: Each step counts closed classified sessions with that step actually observed, separated by evidence or suspicion. Skipped or unknown steps are not filled in. Reaching a page does not prove that an action succeeded.
journey.empty: No agent journeys are available for this selection.

proofHint.verified: Identity confirmed by signature, IP range or reverse DNS. Each proof remains separate.
proofHint.declared: The agent announces an identity that has not been verified. This is not proof of impersonation.
proofHint.other: No confirmed operator identity. These sessions are excluded from verified-agent totals.
proofHint.suspected: Suspected automation is not proof of AI or operator identity. This timeline begins when the detection threshold was reached. Earlier human request details were not retained and are not reconstructed; earlier steps remain unknown.

journey.failuresCaption: Named failures with their eligible session denominator
journey.failuresHint: Shares use only sessions for which the relevant outcome is known. Unknown outcomes, including cache hits without the corresponding event, are excluded. “—” means no valid denominator; it never means success. A session can have several failures.
journey.noFailures: No named failures are available. This does not establish that every action succeeded.
journey.listHint: The last observed step can differ from the furthest observed step. Open sessions can still change. Closure runs every 15 minutes after more than 30 minutes of inactivity; a closed session is not necessarily a conversion.
journey.listCaption: Minimized classified sessions with last and furthest observed steps
journey.timelineHint: Only minimized retained requests are listed. Missing steps and business outcomes remain unknown. Order IDs appear only when a Shopware order event was linked to this agent session.
journey.observationPartial: This session was only partly observed: detection began later or collection was interrupted. Observed steps and known failures are retained; cart and checkout abandonment are not inferred.
journey.noTimeline: No request details remain for this session.

linkageHint.exact: Requests share an incoming context token or session cookie. This links observed requests; it does not identify a person.
linkageHint.probabilistic: A shared provider key or request characteristics may group several visits. This journey is an estimate.

reasonCode.ip_in_official_range: Client IP belongs to an accepted operator range
reasonCode.forward_confirmed_reverse_dns: Reverse DNS confirmed by a forward lookup
reasonCode.expired: Signature is outside its validity window
reasonCode.heuristic_threshold: Behavioural score reached the experimental detection threshold
reasonCode.heuristic_session_context: Request linked to a session already classified as suspected automation

journey.unknownFailures: {count} failure/evidence combinations have no sessions with a known outcome
journey.errorRoutesHint: The 20 most frequent error routes among retained agent requests, including open sessions. These are request counts, not failure rates.
journey.noErrorRoutes: No HTTP error route is retained for this selection.
journey.truncated: The first 500 retained requests are shown. This timeline is incomplete.

heuristics.title: Undeclared automation detection
heuristics.experimentalHint: Detection and false-positive rates have not been validated on real human reference sessions. A suspected session may belong to a person or an ordinary automation tool.
heuristics.privacy: Disabled by default. Scoring runs locally and adds no tracking cookie. Earlier human request details are not reconstructed when a session reaches the threshold.
heuristics.enable: Enable experimental detection of undeclared automation
heuristics.thresholdHint: Use a whole number from 30 to 100. A higher threshold requires a higher score. Changes apply to future observations; existing classifications are retained.
heuristics.invalidThreshold: Enter a whole number from 30 to 100.
heuristics.editorRequired: Editor permission is required to change detection settings.
heuristics.loadFailed: Detection settings could not be loaded. No change has been made.
heuristics.saveFailed: The change could not be confirmed. Reload the settings before trying again.
heuristics.observedHint: Shown separately from verified or declared agents. Excluded from the observed agent numerator and benchmark agent metrics; included in all-session totals.
heuristics.notProof: Suspected automation is not proof of AI or operator identity.
heuristics.scoreHint: The score combines weighted server-side signals. It is neither a probability nor an identity-verification result.
heuristics.journeyWarning: Suspected automation is shown separately. Detection is experimental and has not been calibrated on real human reference sessions. No AI identity is established.
heuristics.timelineStartsAtDetection: This timeline begins when the detection threshold was reached. Earlier human request details were not retained and are not reconstructed; earlier steps remain unknown.

flag.browser_headers_incoherent: Browser headers inconsistent with the user-agent
flag.wildcard_html_accept: Generic Accept header on an HTML page
flag.deep_without_referer: Deep page requested without a Referer
flag.api_without_session_cookie: API request without a storefront session cookie
flag.hosting_network: Client IP in the bundled AWS EC2 eu-west-3 range subset
flag.high_cadence: High request rate across several observations
flag.regular_cadence: Regular request intervals across several observations
flag.cookie_ignored: Expected session cookie not returned across observations
